P-stability and trace integrality give P inside B1 inside P-dual, including closed points. The induced torsion-free/reflexive Morita tensor gives the specified geometric extension F; the opposite-Hom composition gives its exact dual lattice bound.

The retained qualitative residual-anchor construction provides rank M² and actual algebraization; it does not require a bounded-degree finite etale Brauer splitter. Tensoring with the character sum produces a rank-M^4 generator. The induction/restriction identity and Frobenius reciprocity cover noncommuting projective inertia.
Positive root twists yield the exact blockwise order sandwich Mat_d(P)(-C) to Mat_d(P)(2C), and the coarse Hom sandwich Q^d(-C) to Q^d(C). No unshifted matrix-order containment is asserted.

The conclusion explicitly excludes generation/cohomology bounds for arbitrary intermediate lattices, coefficient-flat relative reflexive hulls, finite nilpotent effectivity and a hereditary projective count.
